(7) **Groq/OpenAI params** (#58871, #58857): let Groq use shared Chat parallel_tool_calls + service_tier, send OpenAI Chat options that were silently dropped (provider param forwarding, Alexi provider layer can reference for complete param passthrough). (8) **OpenAI Responses reasoning** (#58872): add OpenAI Responses reasoning mode and context options (OpenAI Responses API, not yet exposed in Alexi, pattern reference for future Responses integration). (9) **Known throttle overflow** (#58866): keep known throttles out of overflow matching (error classification, Alexi `src/core/error-backoff.ts` can add known throttle detection so rate-limit responses don't trigger overflow compaction). (10) **Tool schema conversion refactor** (#58848): convert tool schemas once at registration (perf, Alexi `src/tool/registry.ts` can cache converted schemas to avoid repeated Zod→JSON transform). (11) **Promise/Effect entry refactor** (#58847): make Promise the root entry and move Effect to @opencode/ai/effect (SST internal API refactor, not Alexi pattern). (12) **Video input support** (#58615, #58614): support Responses/Messages video inputs (Gemini/OpenAI video input, Alexi `src/providers/gemini-retry.ts` and `src/providers/openai/` exist, can add video input forwarding when SAP AI Core exposes it).

- **Why**: Alexi can reference these patterns for proactive hardening: (1) **ETag-driven catalog cache**: Alexi `src/providers/modelCatalog.ts` already fetches models.dev catalog once at startup (`catalogFreshness` timestamp), can add ETag header to revalidate stale catalog without full re-fetch (HTTP 304 → keep cached, 200 → replace). (2) **Provider-specific param forwarding**: xAI min_p/top_k, OpenAI Responses reasoning mode, Anthropic fast speed option. Alexi provider adapters (`src/providers/index.ts`, `src/providers/openai/`, `src/providers/gemini-retry.ts`) can add these params when SAP AI Core routing exposes them (currently SAP orchestration layer may not forward all params). (3) **Tool schema conversion cache**: Alexi `src/tool/registry.ts` converts Zod schemas to JSON on every tool call (via `defineTool`), can cache the converted schema at registration time (perf improvement, especially for tools called repeatedly in loops). (4) **Video input forwarding**: Gemini 2.5 and GPT-4o support video URLs/base64, Alexi can add video attachment handling in `src/tool/tools/context.ts` or a new video tool when SAP AI Core exposes native video input. All REFERENCE-ONLY (no user-reported gaps, proactive hardening). Patterns: catalog ETag caching, provider param forwarding, tool schema caching, video input.
